responsive.wide: Keep the dialog bounded rather than expanding with the viewport.
responsive.ultrawide: Do not add diagnostic information merely to consume space.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Descriptions, changed-section labels, destinations, errors, and actions wrap. The dialog scrolls internally when necessary.
responsive.zoomExpectation: All resolution choices remain visible or locally scrollable at 200% text scaling.

accessibility.semanticElement: accessible confirmation dialog for application-controlled transitions and browser-controlled beforeunload prompt for document unload
keyboard: Focus is trapped within the application guard dialog.
Escape and backdrop dismissal resolve as stay rather than discard.
Stay, discard, and save-and-continue are keyboard operable.
Discard is not accidentally activated by Enter unless it is the explicit focused action.
focus: Opening moves focus to the safest logical action or dialog heading according to ConfirmationDialog policy.
Stay restores focus to the originating control.
Save failure keeps focus inside the guard or moves to its error summary.
Successful continuation follows destination focus policy.
announcements: The dialog title and description are announced when opened.
Saving, failure, offline, and conflict state use FormStatus and FormErrorSummary semantics.
Browser unload messaging remains controlled by the browser.
aria: Use the approved modal-dialog foundation.
Associate title and description with the dialog.
Do not rely on a custom beforeunload message.
Buttons require complete action labels.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Stay, save, discard, warning, failure, and conflict meaning use labels, action hierarchy, semantics, and icons in addition to color.

content.minimum: A clear unsaved-change warning and explicit stay and discard choices.
content.typical: Title, description, destination, concise change summary, and optional save-and-continue.
content.maximum: A bounded summary of affected work. Detailed form state remains in the underlying form.
content.wrapping: Warnings, destinations, changed-section labels, status, errors, and actions wrap naturally.
content.truncation: Do not truncate data-loss consequences or action labels.
content.localization: Support expanded warnings, destinations, change summaries, save states, errors, and actions.
content.emptyBehavior: The guard does not render when active is false.
content.technicalContent: Raw route paths, router states, field keys, dirty-field objects, version hashes, and mutation errors are prohibited.

requiredTests: Save failure preserves form and transition

notes: UnsavedChangesGuard is not a draft-persistence system.
Browser beforeunload behavior varies and custom prompt text is not guaranteed.
The owning workflow remains responsible for dirty-state correctness and authoritative save completion.

checks.description: The form-workflow component catalog must validate against the component catalog schema.
checks.remediation: Correct invalid or missing form-workflow component fields.

checks.description: Form-workflow IDs, names, implementations, public imports, and canonical responsibilities must remain unique.
checks.remediation: Resolve duplicate ownership or merge overlapping workflow contracts.

checks.description: Shared workflow components must not execute form submissions, mutations, autosave, draft persistence, permission checks, transport parsing, or conflict resolution.
checks.remediation: Move submission, persistence, authorization, error normalization, and conflict logic to the owning form, feature, query, or route.

checks.description: Form sections must represent coherent user tasks and must preserve logical field order across responsive layouts.
checks.remediation: Split unrelated fields into separate sections and correct DOM order before applying grid placement.

checks.description: FormErrorSummary must use normalized user-facing errors, provide accessible field navigation, and follow the approved focus and announcement policy.
checks.remediation: Correct error normalization, field targets, focus behavior, live-region policy, or adjacent field-error relationships.

checks.description: Field validation, cross-field constraints, submission failure, unavailable dependency, and version conflict must remain semantically distinct.
checks.remediation: Map the failure to the correct FormErrorSummary variant and preserve field-level feedback where applicable.

checks.description: FormActionBar must expose one dominant action, prevent duplicate submission, separate destructive actions, and explain unavailable eligibility.
checks.remediation: Correct action hierarchy, pending state, disabled reason, destructive separation, or callback ownership.

checks.description: Unsaved, saving, saved, failed, offline, restored, and conflict states must remain distinguishable.
checks.remediation: Correct the persistence-state adapter and use the matching FormStatus variant.

checks.description: Saved state must require authoritative persistence confirmation and must not be inferred from optimistic local state.
checks.remediation: Apply saved only after the authoritative persistence source confirms completion.

checks.description: Recoverable validation, save failure, offline state, and version conflict must preserve user-entered values.
checks.remediation: Remove automatic form reset or replacement and introduce explicit conflict or recovery actions.

checks.description: Form sections, error summaries, action bars, and status content must remain readable, keyboard operable, and free from page-level overflow across approved viewports and zoom levels.
checks.remediation: Correct field-column collapse, sticky footer placement, safe-area handling, error wrapping, action stacking, or focus behavior.

checks.description: Page-local form sections, validation summaries, sticky action footers, and persistence labels similar to canonical workflow components require review.
checks.remediation: Reuse the canonical workflow component or document why the local composition requires a distinct contract.
